thread:
sam (AE): ZenithBank wants a Q2 enterprise commit. Traffic: 650 rps peak, ~20k tokens/session, sustained 90m market window. They require p50 < 250ms and 99.9% uptime during the window. Asking for reserved GPU sizing + burst credits + ops handoff.

priya (Sales Eng): 650 rps at 20k tokens is heavy. Do they accept quantized models? That will materially reduce GPU count. Also confirm Private vs Dedicated.

sam (AE): They want Private (VPC) + SOC2/KMS. Procurement asked for monthly cost + worst-case overage and a short ops runbook.

ryan (Solutions): Quick conservative rec: baseline 8 GPUs (quantized) + 3 burst GPUs (prewarmable). Autoscale cap to 11 for up to 20min bursts, token-credit bucket for burst minutes. Use persistent KV cache with 12-24h TTL and selective prefix warm.

kate (SRE): Draft autoscale sample (ops snippet): `autoscale: min:8 reserved:8 burst:3 burst_window_sec:1200 prewarm_schedule: - cron:"0 12 * * 1-5" replicas:10 kv_cache:{enabled:true,persistence:true,ttl_hours:12} degrade: queue_depth>250 for 60s -> fallback_model:zenith-7b-quant`
Callout: KV warmup matters for large contexts; don't expect instant burst efficiency.

anand (Infra): Private deploy notes: AZ spread required for SLA 1/2 GPUs extra for active-active failover. KMS integration test needed; prewarm should validate decrypt permissions. Lead time 2-3 weeks for infra and cert exchange.

priya (Sales Eng): Procurement needs two price scenarios: quantized vs fp16. Use conservative 2.5x efficiency factor for quantized. Include line items: reserved GPU monthly, burst-credit bucket, prewarm-run cost estimate, and worst-case 4x burst events/month scenario.

ryan (Solutions): Action items: (1) kate to run perf bench on provided model/container for 8k and 20k contexts by tomorrow 18:00 UTC; (2) ryan to draft CFO-friendly price table (quantized vs fp16) + example amortized $/token; (3) anand to list infra lead times and KMS checklist; (4) priya to prepare procurement handoff and legal note about SLA window.

qa-bot: Security checklist: outstanding - KMS smoke test, SOC2 attestation, vendor encryption report.

kate (SRE): If we don't get the container in time, fallback rec: reserve 11 quantized GPUs to be safe and 300k monthly token burst credits. Will tune down after bench.

sam (AE): I'll ping ZenithBank for the container and confirm Private deploy. Reopen after kate posts perf numbers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
